scope: Authorized bounded inspection of the single public Airscope Neuron-BERT validation cache; aggregate schema only, no per-trial labels, identifiers, or arrays disclosed.

file_integrity.md5_source: Computed locally after download; no first-party MD5 was published in the inspected metadata.
file_integrity.sha256_source: Computed locally after download; no first-party SHA-256 was published in the inspected metadata.

inspection_controls.container_runtime: non-root uid 501, read-only filesystem, network none, all capabilities dropped, no-new-privileges, 64 PID limit, 512 MiB memory limit, one CPU; only cache and trusted inspector mounted read-only
inspection_controls.unpickling: Only inside the restricted container. Preflight found no extension or persistent-reference opcodes; custom Unpickler allowed four NumPy array/dtype reconstruction globals and rejected other globals.

source_lineage_findings: The published validation notebook names this seed-42 cache, passes None instead of raw data to the dataset class, and its saved output explicitly says 'Validation samples: 17'. Its saved validation F1 is 85.71% on these public labels.

The training script defaults to a single trial-level 80/20 train/validation split with test_ratio 0 and seed 42, writes val_data_seed_42_pca.pkl, and has no five-fold loop. Its split function permits the same mouse pair in train and validation at different trials.

The README separately reports five-fold cross-validation with 19 held-out trials per fold. This cache has 17 examples and no fold identifier; it cannot be assigned to one of those five folds from the inspected evidence.

The training engine selects best_model.pth by validation accuracy. The published checkpoint and notebook therefore expose performance on a validation set used in model selection, not an independent hidden test.

pair_disjoint_assessment.within_this_cache: Technically possible to partition the 17 examples by exact mouse_pair key: at least one three-example pair contains both classes, leaving 14 examples with both classes. This is a very small public 14/3 demonstration split, not an accepted benchmark split.
pair_disjoint_assessment.against_original_training: Cannot establish pair disjointness from the original author's training data because that training payload and trial IDs are absent; the published training pipeline expressly uses a trial-level split that can reuse pairs across train and validation.
pair_disjoint_assessment.hidden_test_readiness: No. All 17 labels are public in the cache, the published model has been selected on this validation set, and no independent held-out payload is available from this file.

reconciliation_with_prior_audits: The earlier deep audit correctly identified the public cache but left its contents unverified; this report verifies 17 labeled samples. The earlier audit's no-payload-downloaded statement is historical to that audit and no longer describes the current authorized inspection.
recommended_disposition: A reproducible public Neuron-BERT validation example can be prepared from this cache, with explicit 17-sample and provenance limits. Do not present it as the published five-fold result or as an independent private Test. Airscope FST and TST remain without located paired labeled data, and FST AUC definition remains unresolved.
